title: NoSQL Document Store Modeling
learningObjectives: Model entities with embedded documents vs normalized references
Design query-first schema patterns optimized for single-read retrieval
Enforce atomic updates using optimistic concurrency control (CAS / version fields)
keyTradeoffs: Denormalization write amplification vs low-latency document read speeds
Document size limits (e.g. MongoDB 16MB) vs splitting into subcollections
commonPitfalls: Treating a document store like an RDBMS and attempting client-side multi-table joins
Unbounded array growth inside a single document
transferPrompt: When query patterns require arbitrary multi-field filtering, how do you pair document stores with full-text search indexes?
